effect.name: GM Starburst Prism
effect.desc: Multi-blade diffraction rays generated from real image highlights with spectral prism color.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec3 rays=vec3(0);float count=clamp(floor(blades+.5),2.0,12.0);for(int b=0;b<12;b++){if(float(b)>=count)break;float a=rotation+3.14159265*float(b)/count;vec2 dir=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));for(int j=1;j<=12;j++){float t=float(j)/12.0,w=(1.0-t)*(1.0-t);vec2 off=dir*rayLengthPx*t/sz;vec3 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+off,0.0,1.0)).rgb;float l=max(max(c.r,c.g),c.b);float h=max(l-threshold,0.0);vec3 spec=.6+.4*cos(vec3(0,2.1,4.2)+t*dispersion*8.0);rays+=c*h*w*spec;}}rays*=intensity/max(count*3.0,1.0)*rayColor.rgb;vec3 outRgb=1.0-(1.0-src.rgb)*(1.0-clamp(rays,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,outRgb,mixAmount),src.a+clamp(max(max(rays.r,rays.g),rays.b),0.0,1.0)*mixAmount*(1.0-src.a));}
